recentItems.title: INK - Official Teaser Trailer - From Danny Boyle & starring Jack O'Connell, Guy Pearce | STUDIOCANAL
recentItems.description:
From director Danny Boyle and starring Jack O'Connell, Guy Pearce and Claire Foy - don't miss INK exclusively in cinemas January 8th 2027. An explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news – one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.

Starring Jack O'Connell, Guy Pearce and Claire Foy and from visionary director Danny Boyle.
